summary.en: Joseph Kabila, former president of the Democratic Republic of Congo, has formed a new political-military front that incorporates the M23 rebels in eastern DRC. His coalition is now fighting alongside M23 against the Congolese army, intensifying combat in the North Kivu region. Security personnel linked to Erik Prince were ambushed, resulting in the death of a former New Zealand special forces officer and wounds to former UFC fighter Tim Kennedy. The conflict remains deadly, with 1,158 battle-related deaths recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Joseph Kabila, tidligere president i Den demokratiske republikken Kongo, har dannet en ny politisk-militær front som innlemmer M23‑opprørerne i Øst-Kongo. Koalisjonen hans kjemper nå sammen med M23 mot den kongolesiske hæren, og intensiverer kampene i Nord-Kivu. Sikkerhetspersonell knyttet til Erik Prince ble overfalt, noe som førte til at en tidligere nyzealandsk spesialstyrkeoffiser ble drept og den tidligere UFC-utøveren Tim Kennedy ble såret. Konflikten forblir dødelig, med 1 158 dødsfall i kamper registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
